history_specification.quadrature: full t-1 empirical quadrature; t-2/t-3 summaries

coach_change.evidence: An undated target-year end can be in-season, so a safe historical comparison is not available.

caveats: Coach change remains unresolved when either cutoff cannot be reconstructed; unknown is never no-change.
coaching_continuity.evidence: A continuous tenure must prove the coach active by the August 15 cutoff.

rank_history.evidence: Each H target uses rank distributions from seasons strictly before the target.

caveats: No archival as-of field is supplied. The absence is not leakage: this is a preseason-semantic class fact, with ordinary source corrections treated as a retrospective-stability caveat.
recruiting_class.evidence: CFBD defines year as recruiting class year. Rank and points evaluate a signed class, not later college performance; that class is finalized before its football season.

caveats: Roster-return corrections may revise old values, but no evidence says revisions incorporate target-season outcomes.
returning_production.evidence: It is previous-season player production filtered by return status into the named season. Target-season games cannot change its previous-production component.

caveats: Old roster/rating records may be corrected; no endpoint-semantic evidence says target-season games enter the metric.
team_talent_composite.evidence: CFBD describes a season's 247Sports roster recruiting-talent composite, not a target-season performance statistic.

transfers.evidence: Portal entry, destination, enrollment, eligibility, and late moves are genuinely time-varying; no frozen cutoff roster reconstruction exists here.

selection.rule: ΔNLL <= -0.005, ΔCRPS <= 0, bootstrap NLL win rate >= .75; choose lowest qualifying ΔNLL else C0
